title: Right Eye and Left Eye
description: This episode of Focus Cast by focuslinks tells the story of the two letter codes that name the eyes on every spectacle prescription. Listeners hear where the letters for the right eye and the left eye come from, why they are spoken letter by letter, and why each eye receives its own row of values. The conversation looks at real mix ups, why the paperwork is checked so carefully, and what happens when one eye needs no correction at all. It ends by gently dismantling the idea that the letter codes exist to confuse patients.
